subtasks: Pick up the coin from the holder and insert it precisely into the coin bank.
Pick up the fallen gold coin lying flat beside the holder and lift it securely for transfer to the bank.
Transfer the held coin to the left gripper, align the coin edge-on with the pink bank's slot and deposit it completely inside. Open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.

Use the right hand, which already holds the coin upright, to carry it above the pink bank and insert it edge-on through the slot. Keep the left hand clear. Release inside, then open both hands and return to their starting poses.
